response.rationale: Myxoid liposarcoma is characterized by myxoid stroma, anastomosing cords, and single-file arrangement of monomorphic cells with nuclear grooves, matching the vignette. Myxofibrosarcoma typically shows more pleomorphism and curvilinear vessels, not described here. Liposarcoma NOS is too nonspecific.

rejected.why: Nonspecific label; does not capture the distinctive myxoid and corded features.
Lacks the characteristic anastomosing cords and single-file pattern; more pleomorphism expected.
